shopStats.source: firecrawl scrape of shop + listing pages, 2026-08-16

priceBand.note: 39 parsed listings; sinks cluster at 492-877, niches 585-675, shelves 247-867, statement bookcase 3209

category: hand-carved natural stone bathroom architecture — wall-mounted marble vanity basins, recessed shower niches, floating wall shelves, wine racks and a travertine bookcase, cut from Calacatta Viola, Calacatta Gold, Carrara, Lilac Marble, Rosso Levanto, Emperador, Fusion Quartzite and Travertine
targetAudience: renovation-stage buyers and the trade: homeowners specifying a bathroom, plus interior designers, architects and contractors sourcing for client projects. Ticket is high (median $562, sinks to $877, bookcase $3209) and the purchase is architectural — the piece is built into a wall, so buyers need dimensions, material certainty and installation confidence before they commit. Shop explicitly serves wholesale/project-based orders.
brandTone: material-first and specification-led. Every listing names the stone before the product (Calacatta Viola Marble Shower Niche, Pentagon Calacatta Gold Marble Sink), repeats '100% natural stone' and 'hand carved / handmade' as the core promise, and frames pieces for 'modern, minimalist, spa-style and luxury interiors'. Voice is calm and technical rather than decorative — it answers a builder's questions: custom size, DDP duties covered, wooden crate packaging, 5-10 day production.
realDifferentiators: Custom size on every piece — 'we can produce in any size you need', the single most repeated promise in listings and the top theme in reviews
DDP shipping — all US orders delivered duty paid, no customs surprise at the door
Production 5-10 business days, then fast worldwide shipping
Secure wooden crate packaging — reviewers specifically mention 'arrived well-wrapped in a wooden box'
Works with interior designers, contractors and businesses on wholesale/project pricing
Each piece unique — natural veining variation stated up front as character, not defect
Returns not accepted (made-to-order natural stone) — makes pre-purchase trust essential, which is exactly the gap a brand site closes
